_notice: Seed assumptions from the team build spec. Bus and MRT-6 fares cite official sources (checked 2026-10-16); VERIFY items are still estimates.

fares.source: bus: BRTA gazette effective 22 Sep 2026; MRT-6: govt fare policy (station chart approximated); rickshaw/CNG: team estimates

source.short: Govt gazette (BRTA chart), ৳2.70/km, minimum ৳10, effective 22 Sep 2026
source.text: Govt gazette: Dhaka and Chattogram metropolitan buses Tk 2.70 per passenger-km (up from Tk 2.53), minimum Tk 10 unchanged; effective 22 Sep 2026

bus._note: minibuses (Tk 2.60/km, minimum Tk 8) and DTCA-area buses (Tk 2.60/km) are not modelled; the team spec's 2.45 was the 2022 rate

source.short: MRT-6 fare policy, ৳5/km, ৳20–100 (official fare is a station chart; per-km rule approximates it)
source.text: MRT-6 fare policy: Tk 5 per km, minimum Tk 20, maximum Tk 100; the official fare is a station-to-station chart, approximated here by the per-km rule. No student discount (no decision as of May 2026); 25% off single journeys for citizens 65+ and persons with disabilities (May 2026), not modelled

source.short: Team estimate: flat fare per line, no official chart in the app

leguna.VERIFY: flat fares per line in seed.json

source.short: Team estimate: unmetered, negotiated fare (range shown)
Team estimate: meters are rarely used, negotiated fare (range shown)

cng.VERIFY: current CNG rates; not in the team spec, added because the problem statement names CNGs as unmetered connectors

_rushHours_assumption: Dhaka office peak windows (Asia/Dhaka time); used when the user does not set rush hour explicitly

boardWait._assumption: bus and metro waits from the spec; leguna and rickshaw waits are team assumptions

rush._assumption: leguna rush multiplier not in spec; set equal to bus

rain._assumption: leguna and walk rain multipliers not in spec

heavyRain._assumption: team assumption, not in spec: heavy rain (rainSeverity 'heavy') slows road modes more and takes CNG and leguna off the road in the rain zone (small engines stall in waterlogging); rickshaws and buses keep running; metro unaffected

ranking._maxDfsNodes: safety limit on DFS work; if reached the result is marked SEARCH_INCOMPLETE (never reached on the seed network)

alerts._assumption: spec says hard = 'edge broken/heavy penalty': blockade, construction and waterlogging break road edges; gridlock doubles time
